zakatClaimEvidence: The Muslim Community Center Chicago explicitly mentions "Zakat Request" as one of its services. They provide an "Online Zakat Form" for applications and an email address (zakat@mccchicago.org) for inquiries. Their website also states, "Charity 'Zakah' One of the most important principles of Islam is that all things belong to God, and that wealth is therefore held by human beings in trust. The word zakat means both 'purification' and 'growth'. Our possessions are purified by setting aside a proportion for those in need, and like the pruning of plants, this cutting back balances and encourages new growth." Furthermore, they have a process for "zakat and/or sadaqa financial assistance" where applications are approved or denied at the discretion of The Muslim Community Center of Chicago. (Source: https://mccchicago.org/zakat-request/)

rich_narrative.summary: The Muslim Community Center (MCC) is a long-standing institution in the Chicago area. It provides religious education, community services, and humanitarian aid. Founded in <cite id="1">1969</cite>, it has grown into a major hub for the local Muslim community. The organization operates several masjids and the <cite id="2">MCC Academy full-time school</cite>. In FY2024, MCC reported <cite id="3">total revenue of $10,751,849</cite>. This represents a steady growth trend with a <cite id="4">3-year CAGR of 7.6%</cite>. The charity maintains a <cite id="5">95/100 overall score from Charity Navigator</cite>. This high rating reflects strong financial health and accountability. MCC is highly efficient in its spending. It directs <cite id="6">93.4% of its expenses to programs</cite> according to recent filings. It also spends only <cite id="7">$0.03 to raise every $1</cite>. This lean fundraising model ensures that donor funds reach the community directly. Beyond education, MCC runs the <cite id="8">Ansar Program and a Green Ramadan Initiative</cite>. It also acts as a grantmaker, distributing <cite id="9">$614,941 in domestic grants</cite> to partners like MedGlobal and Helping Hand for Relief & Development.
